scope: Sidecar-only Qwen4Exp one-layer MTP draft composition at 16-token capacity

implementation.input: independent standard RMSNorm over token embedding H2560 and target widened H10240; branchwise [e,h] concat; Q8_0 eh_proj
implementation.layer: one Qwen4Exp HC + dense attention + 512/top-10 MoE block
implementation.state: independent paged draft K/V and index cursor
implementation.output: widened pre-final-HC hidden plus final HC/lm-head logits

claims.note: Component gate only. Target handoff, prompt priming against real target rows, target verification, public serving, and economics are separate binding gates.
